blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Prior to suitcases (maleta), the purported bagmen of former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co used durable plastic boxes called “duraboxes” to haul cash intended for alleged kickbacks. This is what a witness at a Sandiganbayan Third Division hearing revealed on Thursday. Rodante Orbillo made this known when he took the witness stand before the anti-graft court to testify in the bail hearing of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez. The case stems from P7.44 billion worth of alleged kickbacks from infrastructure projects that reportedly involved the former House leader.
